## Veo Scene Renderer
Called once per scene by the main workflow (sequentially, which also paces the Veo API).

**Flow**: plan attempt -> submit (Veo predictLongRunning) -> poll -> download -> save.
**Fallbacks**: 429/5xx backoff with jitter -> softened prompt on safety blocks -> retry without images -> next model tier (Veo 3.1 -> Fast -> Lite) -> animated still image (Gemini image + ffmpeg Ken-Burns) -> report failure.
Tier order and limits come from the Init Job node of the main workflow.
